newsitem.title: UK: Shell in talks with Bechtel for share of power firm.
newsitem.headline: Shell in talks with Bechtel for share of power firm.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell Group said Thursday it was in talks with U.S. construction company Bechtel to take a 50 percent share in the company's power-generating subsidiary, International Generating Company (InterGen).
Shell subsidiary Shell International Gas Ltd. was aiming to complete negotiations with Bechtel by the end of September, Shell said in a news release.
A company spokesman declined to comment on the likely cost of the purchase.

The partnership would give Shell a share in four power projects under construction -- in Britain, the Philippines, Mexico, and Colombia -- totalling 2,145 megawatts and contracts or mandates for an additional seven projects totalling 4,275 megawatts.
Additionally Intergen has more than 20 other generating projects totalling 10,000 megawatts in various stages of development in addition to pipeline, fuels trading and gas storage activities.
